以小队为单位，每周为一个赛季（周一匹配分区，周二至周日对战）。通过匹配战斗积累积:
Based on squads, each week is a season (Monday for division placement, Tuesday to Sunday for battles). Accumulate points through matched battles, improve squad ranking, and win seasonal rewards.
The highest player level in the squad is used as the benchmark, and after matching, all squad members' levels are unified to the lowest level in the current battle zone.
After matching, you must first set up a defensive lineup before you can challenge. You get 3 free challenges per day, which can be replenished by consuming items.
The opponent list is matched based on the player's power and current points, with 3 free refreshes available daily to refresh opponents.
Players can provide 3 Pokémon to teammates for squad co-op battles. Co-op Pokémon can be used in both offensive and defensive lineups, with a maximum of 3 in use. Pokémon are automatically removed from the lineup if squad members change.
At the end of the season, rankings are calculated based on the squad's total points. Focus on daily challenges, flexibly adjust your lineup, and work with your teammates to aim for first place!

 3）Origin bonus: After dispatching the origin Pokémon, all slots will receive the corresponding origin bonus, and the level of the bonus is determined by the cultivation level of the origin Pokémon. Buffs effect:
 is a buff that can be dispelled by default. Provides a bonus effect to the buff holder for a period of time.
 Debuffs effect: 
 is a debuff that can be dispelled by default. Provides a benefit reduction bonus effect to the buff holder for a period of time.
 Continuous DMG:
 It is a negative effect and can be dispelled by default. The current game's  [DoT] effects are: Burning, Fire, Poison, etc.
Control-impairing effects:
 It is a negative effect and can be dispelled by default. In a certain turn the holder of the negative buff will be subject to the effects of control, the current game control effects are: Taunt, Paralysis, Freeze, Silence, etc.
 Passive effects:
 It will not be affected by the dispel buff effect and will affect the buff holder until death or the whole battle.
 Marking effect:
 A buff of no type that is not affected by dispel buff effects. It will affect the buff holder for a certain turns.
 True DMG:
 Not affected by any defense reduction, DMG bonus, DMG reduction, true DMG will be offset by the shield when deducting life value.

起源宠物有独特的协同进化机制，完成协同进化可以提升起源宠物的星级和解锁其他周边系:
The origin Pokémon has a unique synergy evolution mechanism. Completing the synergy evolution can improve the star level of the origin Pokémon and unlock other peripheral systems.
 Synergy evolution: 
1) Origin Pokémons have 3 synergy Pokémon slots, which need to be filled by the player with a normal Pokémon of Supreme or Mythic quality for synergy evolution.
2) Normal Pokémons can only participate in one of the origin Pokémons for synergy, and cannot synergize multiple origin Pokémons at the same time.(
3) After completing the synergy by the synergy of the origin of the Pokémon will be based on the synergy of the Pokémon's star, gear, plate, exclusive trinkets these peripheral systems to obtain their own corresponding system of nurturing effects, the specific rules are as follows:
 1.. Star: The initial star of all origin Pokémons is 5 stars, when the synergy is completed, the star will become the average star of the synergistic Pokémons, the origin Pokémons will be affected by the star to unlock the corresponding talents and passives. If all 3 Pokémons in the synergy are of Mythic quality, they will receive an additional 8% attribute bonus.
 2.Plate: unlocked when the origin Pokémon reaches 6 stars, the level of the Plate is equal to the average of the Plate levels of all synergistic Pokémons.
 3.Trinkets: unlocked when the origin Pokémon reaches 7 stars, the level of the trinket is equal to the average of all synergistic Pokémon trinket levels.
 4.Potential development: unlocked when the origin Pokémon reaches 7 stars, requiring the player to develop the potential bonuses that need to be enhanced.
 5. Gear: It is divided into normal gear and advanced gear, and is calculated by the average gear level of th each part of the synergistic Pokémons. When all the synergistic Pokémons are equipped with advanced gear, the gear of the synergistic Pokémons will become the advanced gear of their professions, and the enhancement level will be calculated equally.
 6.Orb: the need to synergize Pokémons are assembled full of red quality Orb, and the level of Orb must reach 3 levels to unlock, unlock the origin Pokémon requires players to choose their own Orb inlay.

Gameplay Introduction:

1、This is a cross-server matching gameplay based on guilds, with weekly cycles for seasons. Sign-ups start every Monday and grouping takes place on Tuesday.

2、There are restrictions on the number of Pokémons that can be deployed and the number of times they can be deployed. Players can form a team of six Pokémons to play the game each time.

3、Players can encounter wild Pokémons, meet other players, and obtain Pokémon eggs while exploring the current grid.

4、A timed refresh of the legendary boss occurs in the gameplay, and players can obtain rewards by attacking the boss.

5、After the legendary boss is killed, the killer will obtain a legendary egg, and the guilds that participate in hatching the egg will each receive rewards. The killer needs to protect the legendary egg in the form of defending the title.

Tournament stages: 
1) Each league group has 4 grading: Elf Orb Level, Super Ball Level, Advanced Ball Level and Master Ball Level. (
2) The former 3 grading are PVE Barriers Match, where all participating players start at the first level of the Elf Ball Level to challenge each level, and there are great rewards for winning the level. The next Super Ball Level will be available only if all levels of the Elf Ball level are cleared. (
3) Wednesday and Friday are the Super Ball Level and the Advanced Ball Level respectively. Both grading require passing all levels of the former level, and the player account must reach the corresponding entry requirements to participate in barriers. (
4) The Ranking will only record 60 players, the higher the challenge level and the earlier the player passes the level, the higher the ranking will be. (
5) On Sunday, Master Ball Level will be opened, Master Ball Level is a PVP battle, the tournament is a knockout system. The top 8 players in Ranking will be registered for participation when the grading is opened, and the system will assign them their respective players to play against each other. Players who are not selected can go to see the creation of the strongest champion of this league grouping, and other levels of the grading can still participate in the challenge. 
6) The Knockout of the Master Ball Level will be divided into three rounds, each round the winner advances to the loser eliminated, each round before the opening of the players have only 1 opportunity to modify the lineup, the participating players please pay attention to adjust your best lineup. 
The first round of 8 into 4 match time: preparation phase 14:00 ~ 14:30, contestants can adjust the lineup during this period, the match phase starts at 14:30. 
The second round of 4 into 2 match time: preparation phase 16:00 ~ 16:30, contestants can adjust the lineup during this period, the match phase starts at 16:30. 
The third round of the finals match time: preparation phase 18:00 ~ 18:30, contestants can adjust the lineup during this period, the match phase starts at 18:30.

Competition Stages: 
1) Each league group has 4 levels, namely Elf Ball, Super Ball, Advanced Ball and Master Ball. 
2) The first 3 levels are PVE matches, where all players start at level 1 of the Pixie Ball level and challenge each level one by one, with generous rewards for winning the challenge. All players will be rewarded for winning the challenge. Passing all levels of the Pixie Sphere level is the only way to enter the next level of the Super Sphere level. 
3) Wednesday and Friday are for Super Ball and Advanced Ball levels respectively, both levels require passing all levels of the former level, and also require the player's account to meet the corresponding entry conditions before they can participate in the challenge. 
4) Only 60 players will be recorded in the Leaderboard, the higher the number of levels challenged and the earlier the level is cleared, the higher the priority will be given to the rankings. 
5) The Master Ball leveling will be opened on Sunday. The Master Ball leveling is a PVP match, and the tournament is a knockout system. The top 8 players on the leaderboard will be entered into the tournament and will be assigned their respective opponents when the levelling starts. Players who do not make the cut can go to see the strongest champions of the league's divisions, and can still participate in the challenges of the other graded levels. 
6) The elimination round of the Master Ball level will be divided into three rounds of matches, with the winner advancing and the loser eliminated in each round, and players will only have 1 chance to modify their lineups before each round opens, so participating players should pay attention to adjusting their best lineups. 
 First round 8 into 4 competition time: preparation stage 14:00 ~ 14:30 participants can adjust the lineup during this period, the competition stage 14:30 start 
 Second round 4 into 2 competition time: preparation stage 16:00 ~ 16:30 participants can adjust the lineup during this period, the competition stage 14:00 start 
 The third round of the finals competition time: preparation stage 18:00 ~ 18:30 Participants can adjust their line-ups during this period, the competition phase starts at 18:30
